newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE AGRIBANK SEEN ON STREAM MID-1997.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE AGRIBANK SEEN ON STREAM MID-1997.

text.p: Zimbabwe's state-owned Agricultural Finance Corporation (AFC) is expected to launch its proposed commercial bank, Agribank, by June if all legal and administrative procedures are completed, a government minister said on Monday.

Agriculture Minister Denis Norman said in a statement the government had yet to change the AFC's legal status to enable it to operate the bank which would provide short and long-term credit to commercial farmers.
Agribank would have a minimum share capital of Z$50 million initially and would among other services offer savings, fixed and call accounts as well as current accounts and overdraft facilities.
Norman said the AFC would have to source the bank's capital on its own because the government would not help it to raise it.
